title: unified-rollouts-add-preflight-e2e-safety-guards-and-quarantine
author: Priya Shah
description: Adds a preflight e2e safety-guard stage and quarantine capability to the unified rollouts engine. Motivation: we recently observed a rollout-induced regression in ranking latency that passed unit tests but only manifested under production-like traffic patterns. This PR introduces a lightweight preflight runner that executes configurable e2e probes against candidate model variants in a quarantined shadow environment, collects rollout telemetry (latency_p50/95, error_rate, token_retries, quality_checks), and wires gating rules to the autorollback engine so rollouts can be automatically paused or quarantined when the preflight metrics exceed thresholds. Implemented pieces: 1) preflight runner service (rollouts/preflight/runner.go) with pluggable probe adapters, 2) quarantine routing and staged shadowing in rollouts/engine/router.go, 3) autorollback gating hooks and composite metric evaluation in rollouts/engine/autorollback.py, 4) e2e job manifests and test harness (rollouts/tests/e2e/preflight.yaml and tests/e2e/preflight_runner_test.go), 5) observability: new prometheus metrics and dashboards (observability/metrics/rollouts.prom, docs/dashboards/rollouts_preflight.md), 6) console UI to configure preflight policies (console/rollouts_ui.tsx) and docs (docs/unified-rollouts/preflight.md). Rollout behavior: preflight runs on a cloned candidate pinned to a dedicated quarantine pool; if composite_metric > threshold for X consecutive probes the system marks the candidate as QUARANTINED and triggers a rollback or manual review depending on policy. Backwards compatible: default preflight is disabled; existing rollouts continue to behave as before. Checklist: [x] design doc (ENG-2042) linked, [x] unit tests added, [x] e2e preflight job and integration tests, [x] metrics and dashboards updated, [x] docs and console UI changes, [x] canary rollout of feature flags. Testing notes: ran local e2e harness with synthetic traffic and validated gating logic, ran canary against internal staging (200k requests) — observed expected quarantine when we injected latency regressions. Impact: improves safety for canary/AB/shadow workflows with minimal overhead when disabled. Linear/Jira references included.
